name: Team Workload

native.query: SELECT assignee_id, COUNT(*) as open_tasks FROM prj_tasks WHERE status IN ('TODO','IN_PROGRESS') AND deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY assignee_id ORDER BY open_tasks DESC
SELECT ms.name, p.name as project, ms.due_date, ms.status FROM prj_milestones ms JOIN prj_projects p ON p.id = ms.project_id WHERE ms.status != 'DONE' AND ms.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY ms.due_date
